name: Panabyte Technologies Limited
about: Panabyte Technologies Limited engages in the trading of consumer electronic and electrical goods, and IT hardware and its peripherals in India. The company's products include access control and time attendance management; canteen management; access control panel with anti tailgating detector; smart parking solution; E-surveillance and CCTV surveillance system; perimeter security solutions; fire detection and alarm system; and other IT infra products. It also provides installation services, as well as maintenance of surveillance and biometric systems; technology solutions and IOT products; transportation and smart mobility; smart energy solutions; distribution of electronic products under the WALKER brand; building management systems; smart city surveillance; operation and maintenance services; video analytics and mobile applications; system integration; and electronic and security systems, card printing, asset management, and maintenance services. In addition, the company operates in the information technology enabled services (ITES), electronic security and surveillance solutions, and technology products; and diverse technology-driven business verticals delivering end-to-end solutions in electronic security infrastructure, Al- Integrated ELV and workforce solutions, project management, business systems integration, IT consulting, and managed services and lifecycle support services. Further, it engages in the manufacture, production, supply, and service of advanced technology solutions. The company serves real estate, hospitality and tourism, airports and ports, corporate, defense, BFSI, oil and gas, and healthcare industries. The company was formerly known as Panache Innovations Limited and changed its name to Panabyte Technologies Limited in October 2022. Panabyte Technologies Limited was incorporated in 1981 and is based in Thane, India.
